pkgTitle: Continuing from an earlier solved version
title: FQ1: three frozen schemas each accept one more value
body: The solver setting `globalization.eo_recovery` gains the new recovery value. `continuation.type`, in the attempt context and in the certificate's branch provenance, changes from the single value `specification_continuation` to a choice of it or `revision_continuation`.
No member is added, and every existing document validates unchanged.

options.label: Yes, widen them
options.detail: Built this way; merge after your yes.
